run_linear_probe_training: run the main training loop to train a linear classifier on frozen ViT features with optional mixup and cutmix augmentation
run_validation_evaluation: run the validate_network function to evaluate a frozen ViT model with a linear classifier on a validation dataset
run_single_epoch_training: run the train function for one epoch of linear classifier training using intermediate ViT layer outputs
create_linear_classifier: create a LinearClassifier module with a single linear layer initialized with normal weights and zero bias
run_evaluation_only: run the main function with the evaluate flag to load a checkpoint and test accuracy on validation images
